title: Fran Tarkenton raves about Kirk Cousins's return to Minnesota

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Fran Tarkenton raves about Kirk Cousins's return to Minnesota
sources.description: On Monday night, I was explaining to my wife the bizarre situation in Minnesota, where a championship-caliber defense has been paired with an offense that would have trouble scoring a touchdown in the lower divisions of college football.
